items.title: Miner Street Metra Parking Lot Set for Resurfacing Published on November 02, 2026 The Metra parking lot located at 1291 Northwest Highway (west of Graceland Avenue) will be closed for repairs and resurfacing starting Thursday, November 5th. It is scheduled to re-open sometime during the middle to end of the following week (weather permitting). Tagged as: , Public Notices

Des Plaines Upgrades 911 Services with Unified Dispatch Published on October 27, 2026 Effective today (October 27, 2026), the Des Plaines Fire Department begins receiving fire and emergency medical dispatch services from the Cook County Sheriff’s Police 911 Center. The center already provides dispatch services for the Des Plaines Police Department. The change puts the City’s police, fire, and emergency medical dispatch services under one provider. Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices

Water Main Work to Temporarily Close E. Algonquin Road & Deane Street Published on October 16, 2026 As part of the City’s 2026 Capital Improvement Program, installation of a new water main on E. Algonquin Road is scheduled to begin the week of October 19, 2026. E. Algonquin Road and Deane Street will be closed to through traffic for approximately four weeks. Motorists should plan alternate routes and follow posted detour signs. Tagged as: , Public Notices

DPPD Releases Video & Audio Recordings of Officer-Involved Shooting Published on September 30, 2026 On September 9, 2026, at approximately 2:32 p.m., a frantic resident of 2047 E. Touhy Avenue called 911 to request assistance from the Des Plaines Police Department because her son (Babidi) was threatening to kill her while having a bipolar manic episode. During the call, Babidi was breaking windows after the caller locked him out of the home for her safety... Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices
